title: Recertifying decisions via e-closure: uniform improvements of conformal risk control and randomized e-BH
abstract: arXiv:2610.35821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Statistical procedures often control expected loss at a prescribed level while leaving part of their risk budget unused. Building on the e-value representation of risk-controlled decisions and the e-closure principle for multiple testing, we formulate recertification, a general paradigm for improving procedures by exploiting computable slack in their validity certificates. A valid procedure's losses normalized by their risk budgets form a state-indexed e-value collection; conversely, decisions whose normalized losses are bounded by this collection inherit its risk guarantees. Recertification uses distributional structure to quantify slack, enlarge the certifying e-values while preserving validity, and construct less conservative decisions.   We develop two applications. For conformal risk control (CRC) with a known loss family, recertification redistributes unused risk budget among the held-out points of each hypothetical augmented sam

translated_title: 通过e-闭包重新认证决策：共形风险控制与随机化e-BH的一致改进
translated_abstract: 统计程序通常在规定水平上控制期望损失，同时留下部分风险预算未被利用。基于风险受控决策的e值表示以及多重检验中的e-闭包原则，我们提出了“重新认证”这一通用范式，通过利用有效性证书中可计算的松弛来改进统计程序。一个有效程序的损失按其风险预算归一化后，构成一个以状态为索引的e值集合；反之，归一化损失受该集合约束的决策将继承其风险保证。重新认证利用分布结构来量化松弛，在保持有效性的前提下扩大认证e值，从而构造出保守性更低的决策。我们开发了两个应用：对于已知损失族的共形风险控制（CRC），重新认证在每个假设增广样本的留出点之间重新分配未使用的风险预算……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出“重新认证”这一通用范式，借助e-闭包原理利用风险控制程序有效性证书中的可计算松弛，统一改进了共形风险控制和随机化e-BH方法，构造出更少保守的决策。
en_tdlr: Proposes "recertification," a general paradigm that leverages the e-closure principle to exploit computable slack in validity certificates, uniformly improving conformal risk control and randomized e-BH with less conservative decisions.
